name: Algebraic Unfactored Constraint
description: Replaced the seed's modular arithmetic with an unfactored algebraic equation (u*e_u + v*e_v != u*e_v + v*e_u). This is mathematically identical to e_u != e_v, but it prevents the model from pattern-matching the problem to standard graph coloring. As a result, the model fails to deploy the degree-descending heuristic necessary to pass the time limit on 40-vertex instances, falling back to naive CSP backtracking which TLEs.
